parole.significato: A small case, often flat and often made of leather, for keeping money (especially paper money), credit cards, etc.
parole.testo: From Middle English walet (“a bag, knapsack”), of uncertain origin. Possibly from an assumed Old Northern French *walet (“a roll; bag; a knapsack”), from Proto-Germanic *wal- (“to roll”). More at walk, well, wallow.
